meta.name: ecommerce-copywriter
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在需要为多品类商品创作或优化营销图片文案时使用。自动提炼核心卖点，生成带emoji的吸睛标题与直击痛点的场景化正文，一键产出高转化率电商文案，省时省力大幅提升商品点击与购买转化！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提炼商品卖点，生成带表情的吸睛营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要为电商商品撰写吸引人的标题和描述
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling product copy from key selling points
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write product titles and descriptions for online stores

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为电商商品写图片文案：先问你产品名称、卖点、目标用户，再按痛点、产品、卖点、行动召唤四段结构，产出带 emoji 的标题和正文，也能改写已有文案。
howto.when: 当你提出电商文案创作或优化需求、要为商品写营销文案时接管，覆盖智能家居、数码配件、美妆护肤等多品类。

say.text: 帮我给这款智能睡眠眼罩写一段电商文案
say.note: 它会先问卖点、价格和目标用户再出稿

say.text: 把这段已有的商品文案优化一下，标题更吸睛
say.note: 会加 emoji，重写痛点段落与卖点

say.text: 给这款充电宝写标题和四段正文，适当加 emoji
say.note: 按四段结构输出 Markdown 格式文案

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes e-commerce image copy: it first asks for product name, selling points and target users, then outputs an emoji title and a four-part body (pain point, product, selling points, call to action), and can also rewrite existing copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for e-commerce copy creation or optimization, or need marketing copy for a product; covers smart home, digital accessories, beauty and skincare, and other categories.

say_en.text: Write e-commerce copy for this smart sleep eye mask
say_en.note: It asks for selling points, price and audience first

say_en.text: Optimize this existing product copy and make the title catchier
say_en.note: Adds emoji and rewrites the pain point and selling points

say_en.text: Write a title and four-part body for this power bank with some emoji
say_en.note: Outputs Markdown copy in the four-part structure
